summary: An organization allied with a new member distances itself from an early vote.
realLife: A national suffrage organization broke with Jeannette Rankin over her vote against US entry into World War I.
inGame: needs: an organization's response to a named member's recorded vote.

turns.what: The officers defend the member at the next meeting.
turns.pulledBy: The organization's adopted position matches the vote.
turns.writesBack: The group puts its support on record.

turns.what: The officers keep the member on the program but withdraw their invitation to speak.
turns.pulledBy: Local chapters split over the vote.
turns.writesBack: The member attends as a guest.
